title: Lunar dust prevented a fourth EVA for Apollo astronauts

tellings.quote: The dust was uh um was very problematic for the Apollo astronauts where they couldn't even do a fourth EVA.

plain: Moon dust caused the Apollo astronauts so much trouble that they could not manage a fourth EVA, a walk outside the spacecraft on the Moon's surface, according to a NASA engineer named Charles Buhler. He mentions it in passing on the program that landed Americans on the Moon between 1969 and 1972, as a sign of how hard the dust is to deal with.
